name: korbelin_m21_t800s_tai
reference: Korbelin, Dreiner & Fiedler, 'Impact of temperature on LVI-damage and tensile and compressive residual strength of CFRP', Composites Part C: Open Access 3 (2020) 100074, doi:10.1016/j.jcomc.2020.100074 (CC BY 4.0; TUHH Open Research hdl 11420/8990). Hexcel HexPly M21/35%/268/T800S, [45/0/-45/90]2s, 4.08 mm (0.255 mm plies). Tension coupons 250 x 60 mm (x along the load), impacted at 20 C on a 40% scaled-down ASTM D7136 support (50 x 30 mm window, simply supported, impact_panel) with a 5.34 kg, 12 mm hemispherical impactor at 25 J (Table 2; the text says 12.5 mm), then tested in tension at 20 C in a jig that clamps 5 mm of each edge to suppress free-edge delamination. measured_strength_MPa: the five coupons of Fig. 17, and measured_pristine_MPa the mean of its five unimpacted coupons, read from the figure's vector marker coordinates (y axis from the 700-1100 MPa tick labels); the means reproduce the text's 11.1% (20 C) and 18.58% (80 C) reductions and its 25.01% for the three lowest 80 C coupons. measured_dpa_mm2 (1199) and measured_dent_mm (0.151) are the 20 C means of Figs. 8 and 7, the same for every case. The five coupons impacted at 80 C (736.8-958.5 MPa, fibre failure on the impacted face) are left out: the model has no impact temperature. There is no M21/T800S preset; T800S/3900-2B (same fibre, also interlayer-toughened) stands in. The cases are scored on knockdown x measured_pristine_MPa, so only the damage mapping and Kt_inf (3.0, quasi-isotropic) use the proxy, and the predicted footprint fills the 30 mm wide support window.
gate_note: One impact condition (five coupons), used to fit tai_notch_fraction: in-sample. The 0.05 adopted puts the mean knockdown at 0.875 against 0.889 measured; the coupons scatter 0.85-0.97. The material is a proxy. The previous whole-footprint TAI model scored 57% (knockdown 0.378).
